intent: A Figma-style layers tree: data-driven LayerNode[] with nesting. Each row is a chevron (if a group) + type icon + name + visibility/lock. Component/instance rows use the brand accent.
use_when: Showing and selecting the document's layer hierarchy.
dont_use_when: A flat list — use ListCell rows.

slots.nodes: LayerNode[] (id, name, type, children, hidden, locked, autoLayout, maskSource).

tokens.note: Light theme, c-* tokens only; no hardcoded hex — verified.

a11y.nesting: chevron toggles group expansion; keyboard tree navigation.
a11y.perRow: visibility (eye) and lock toggles carry labels.
